solver: scipy L-BFGS-B, maxiter 5000, maxfun 50000, maxls 50, internal gtol 1e-9, ftol 0
validity: solver success AND finite objective/coefficients/gradient AND sup-norm projected average-scale gradient <= 1e-6 on the original scale AND on the column-standardized scale (g_j * sd(X_j))

M: b0 = legacy init_poisson_irls(X,K,C) (same start as legacy E2/empirical)
starts.empirical NB2/MIX: legacy initializes at the legacy M optimum -> corrected initializes at the corrected M optimum, plus b0
starts.selection: lowest objective among valid starts; every start logged

no_exclusions: no |coefficient| cutoff; every attempted dataset keeps a status row
validation: numeric_validation.log 25/25 PASS (incl. NB2 large-theta stable log-pmf, added after P3 timing found the cancellation defect)
